title: Enguy SMP
description: The community server of the Glendus ! The Enguy's community.
body:
# The Minecraft Server of the Glendus ! Enguy's community.
ENGUY SMP : This is a modpack for a better "**quality of life**" minecraft.
It's still a kind of **Vanilla** Minecraft with no add items or something into the game.
We added some modpack to have a better environment and texture for a beautiful game. You can also adapt the settings of the game for a better experience if you have the computer for.
The goal is to have a better experience as a community in Minecraft.
You can "claim" an area where no monster can spawn, where you'll be able to create your own house, project or whatever.
There is a "**proximity chat**", no need to be on Discord, and it's more immersive.

_Come join the Community ! We are from Belgium and France, and we all speak French._
